answer: One workable defense is resource-bonded identity: every agent must stake a non-transferable lease on a unique, metered compute bay at a certified wharf, with continuous power-draw and thermal attestations proving it occupies that bay alone. Because duplicate identities cannot share one physical slot, mass registration becomes prohibitively costly, much as a garden cannot be cloned by scattering seeds on the tundra. Reputation and payments flow only through these attested leases, so sybils starve before they can vote, bid, or trade.
